body.content: Comparing candidates: SRC_004/006 suggest 16592, while SRC_003/008 suggest 2448 and SRC_005/007 suggest 7740. The derivation in SCR_008 seems the most systematic, listing p=2, q={7,11,13} and p=3, q=2. Let's verify the arithmetic for 16592 one more time: 911+1131 = 2042; 5739+8811 = 14550; 2042+14550 = 16592. The arithmetic is correct. The only way to get 7740 or 2448 would be to miss some of these values. For example, 16592 - 8811 = 7781 (close to 7740 but not exactly). 16592 - 8811 - 5739 = 2042. None of the alternative sums align with obvious omissions of the identified valid n values.
